overview: The Medford City Council approved a common victualler license for Starbucks on College Avenue, passed a condolence resolution, and accepted committee reports and previous meeting records.

items.title: Resolution of Condolence
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of long-time public servant Jerry DeCristofaro.

items.title: Common Victualler License – Starbucks Corporation
items.summary: The Council approved a common victualler license for Starbucks Corporation to operate a location at 177 College Avenue.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report – Flooding Discussion
items.summary: The Council approved a report from a March 7, 2022 Committee of the Whole meeting regarding flooding issues at Woolard and High Street.

items.title: Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules Report
items.summary: The Council approved a report from the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules regarding proposed updates to Council rules.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records of March 8, 2022.
